sections.shortTitle: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1984
LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils,
Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd May, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of section 23, Act XXXV of 1973

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1984
LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils,
Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd May, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information.
2. Amendment of section 23, Act XXXV of 1973.--In the Legal Practi tioners
and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), in section 23, in clause (b), for
the lull-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted and there after the
following proviso shall be added, and shall be deemed always to have been so
added, namely :-
"Provided
that no person shall call himself, or hold himself out as, an Advocate of the
Supreme Court until he has signed the roll of Advocates kept under the Rules of
the Supreme Court, and the right of a person to appear, a-;t and plead before
that Court shall be subject to the said Rules.".
